cohort: 83 pregnant women who underwent myomectomy during cesarean section (Group A) and 80 pregnant women who underwent cesarean section only (Group B)
finding: Myomectomy during cesarean section was found to be safe and feasible, with no significant difference in blood transfusion rates or changes in hemoglobin levels between the groups, although surgery and hospitalization durations were longer in the myomectomy group.
